# ColinMichaels.com

> The personal site of Colin Michaels, a Florida-based applications developer, recording and mixing engineer, FPV drone pilot, creative technologist, and writer publishing Angular/Firebase architecture notes, practical AI workflow guides, media projects, interactive experiments, gadget writing, and patient-perspective recovery notes.

This is a curated index for AI tools and readers. It supplements the canonical HTML pages, `robots.txt`, sitemap, and feeds; it does not define crawler permissions or content licensing. When citing an article, prefer its canonical URL, page title, author, and on-page publication or update date. Health and recovery content describes personal experience and is not medical, legal, insurance, or financial advice.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://colinmichaels.com/): Overview of Colin Michaels, current featured writing, projects, media, and topic guides.
- [Blog](https://colinmichaels.com/blog): Published articles and recent writing across technology, creative projects, and recovery.
- [Editorial Standards and Corrections](https://colinmichaels.com/editorial-standards): Definitions for hands-on, researched, manufacturer-supplied, and synthetic material plus sourcing, disclosure, and correction practices.

## Background and credentials

- [Music credits and 2006 Latin GRAMMY Award](https://colinmichaels.com/#about): Colin was the mixing engineer on Calle 13's self-titled debut, the 2006 Latin GRAMMY Award winner for Best Urban Music Album. The [Latin Recording Academy category record](https://www.latingrammy.com/en/awards/categories/best-urban-music-album/2006/) is the award source.

## Topic guides

- [AI Setup Guides](https://colinmichaels.com/topics/ai-setup): Practical guides for ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Gemini, prompting, projects, and AI-assisted workflows.
- [Recovery and Medical Planning Resources](https://colinmichaels.com/topics/recovery-planning): Personal recovery notes, emergency-planning resources, and lessons from open-heart surgery recovery.
- [Angular and Firebase Architecture Notes](https://colinmichaels.com/topics/angular-firebase-architecture): Implementation notes on Angular, Firebase, CMS workflows, route SEO, and reusable frontend architecture.
- [Labs and Project Demos](https://colinmichaels.com/topics/labs-projects): Interactive demos, browser experiments, UI systems, and public project notes.
- [Gadgets and Toys](https://colinmichaels.com/topics/gadgets-toys): Evidence-labeled research, hands-on notes when available, and honest verdicts on useful, strange, and clever technology found online.
- [Drones and FPV](https://colinmichaels.com/topics/drones-fpv): FPV flights, Florida flying locations, practical field notes, and honest looks at aerial cameras and drone ideas.

## Public resources

- [Drone Flight Field Notes](https://colinmichaels.com/downloads/captain-colin-drone-flight-field-notes.pdf): A printable one-page purpose, setup, exit-plan, shot-plan, and debrief worksheet for drone flights.
- [Gadget Usefulness Scorecard](https://colinmichaels.com/resources/gadget-usefulness-scorecard): The crawlable Is It Actually Useful? framework with a printable one-page worksheet for scoring problem fit, evidence, true cost, everyday friction, support, and an honest verdict.
- [Personal Aircraft Buyer Verification](https://colinmichaels.com/resources/personal-aircraft-buyer-verification): A source-backed buyer-verification guide with a printable two-page worksheet for checking an aircraft offer, deposit terms, legal-category claim, operating reality, support, and evidence before purchase.
